A.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize fraction units
skills.definition: Make fraction parts comparable by finding a common denominator and rewriting equivalent fractions, or by rewriting a whole number as a quantity with fractional parts such as 0/d.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator and converts one or both fractions.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a mixed form with fractional part 0/d to align fraction units for subtraction.
Tag when the step states that fraction parts are already in the needed denominator after checking alignment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no rewriting or denominator alignment is performed.
Do not tag pure subtraction steps after the fractions are already aligned.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number into a standard mixed number; that belongs to S02.

skills.name: Normalize mixed numbers
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number with an improper fractional part into an equivalent standard mixed number before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number like 2 3/2 or 1 4/3 is converted to an equivalent mixed number with a proper fraction part.
Tag when the solution explicitly says to normalize an improper fraction part before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversions of simple fractions.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part during subtraction; that belongs to S04.
Do not tag combining whole and fractional results into the final answer.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators and/or subtract the whole-number parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a common denominator.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when a step subtracts whole and fraction parts directly without borrowing because the parts are already aligned.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is creating a common denominator or rewriting a whole number with 0/d; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers; that belongs to S02.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps used because the fractional subtraction would be negative; that belongs to S04.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify result
skills.definition: When needed, borrow 1 from the whole part to continue subtraction, then express the final result in lowest terms or as an integer/mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows or regroups 1 whole into fractional units to avoid a negative fractional part.
Tag when the solution simplifies a fraction such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when a zero fraction is reduced to a whole number result such as 0/3 = 0 or 1 + 0/8 = 1.
Tag when the final step combines the whole and fractional parts into the reported mixed number or integer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag straightforward subtraction steps that do not involve regrouping or simplification.
Do not tag denominator-finding or equivalent-fraction conversion; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers; that belongs to S02.

B.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers, including common denominators, denominator alignment, borrowing, normalization, and simplification

skills.name: Align fraction forms
skills.definition: Rewrite quantities into compatible fractional forms before subtraction, including finding a common denominator or rewriting a whole number as a number with a fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution finds an LCD/common denominator and converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/n or as an equivalent mixed-number-compatible form for subtraction.
Tag when fraction parts are explicitly rewritten so the subtraction can be carried out with matching denominators.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no rewriting/conversion is performed.
Do not tag pure subtraction steps after the forms are already aligned.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number into a standard mixed number; that belongs to S02.

skills.name: Normalize mixed numbers
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number with an improper fractional part into an equivalent standard mixed number before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number such as 2 3/2 or 1 4/3 is rewritten into an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when the solver explicitly states 'normalize' or performs the equivalent conversion from improper fractional part to whole-plus-proper-fraction form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversions between fractions.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a whole plus 0/n.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part during subtraction; that belongs to S04.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts of mixed numbers once the forms are compatible.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted directly without borrowing.
Tag when subtraction is performed after denominator alignment, even if the result is later simplified or combined.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is to create a common denominator or rewrite forms first; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag steps whose main purpose is normalization of improper mixed numbers; that belongs to S02.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps used because the fractional part would otherwise be negative; that belongs to S04.

skills.name: Borrow and simplify
skills.definition: Regroup by borrowing 1 from the whole part when needed and express the final result in lowest terms or integer form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to n/n to continue fraction subtraction.
Tag when a negative fractional difference is resolved by regrouping from the whole part.
Tag when the solution simplifies a fractional result to lowest terms or reduces a zero-fraction result to an integer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag direct subtraction that does not require regrouping and does not include simplification.
Do not tag denominator alignment or rewriting steps before subtraction; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers; that belongs to S02.

C.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers, including common denominators, denominator alignment, borrowing, normalization, and simplification

skills.name: Align fraction forms
skills.definition: Rewrite quantities into compatible fractional form before subtraction, including finding a common denominator or expressing a whole number with a fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution finds an LCD/common denominator and converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/n to match a fractional denominator.
Tag when fraction parts are explicitly rewritten so the subtraction can be performed with matched denominators.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no rewriting is performed.
Do not tag mere problem classification statements such as 'Type C' or 'Type E' unless an actual rewrite/conversion is carried out.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number into a standard mixed number; that belongs to S02.

skills.name: Normalize mixed numbers
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number with an improper fractional part into an equivalent standard mixed number before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number such as 2 3/2 or 1 4/3 is rewritten as an equivalent mixed number with a proper fractional part.
Tag when the solver explicitly states 'normalize' or performs the equivalent conversion before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversions between fractions.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a whole plus 0/n; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping during subtraction; that belongs to S04.

skills.name: Subtract matched parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts once the forms are compatible.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts numerators of like-denominator fractions.
Tag when the solution subtracts whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers without regrouping.
Tag when subtraction is performed after denominators have been aligned or after normalization.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag preparatory rewriting steps such as finding an LCD or rewriting a whole number; those belong to S01.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers; that belongs to S02.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps used because the fractional part would otherwise be negative; that belongs to S04.
Do not tag simplification-only steps unless subtraction is also performed in that step.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: Handle cases requiring borrowing from the whole part and reduce the resulting fraction or zero form to lowest terms/final form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows 1 from the whole part to make the fractional subtraction possible.
Tag when the solution converts results such as 2/10 to 1/5, 9/12 to 3/4, or 0/3 to 0.
Tag when regrouping and final reduction are both part of producing the valid final result.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag straightforward subtraction that does not require borrowing and does not include a simplification step.
Do not tag denominator alignment or rewriting steps; those belong to S01.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers; that belongs to S02.
